overview.note: Everything an operator manages lives in the menu. Each card opens one area.

menuOrder.title: Menu order
menuOrder.note: Choose which entries appear in the top bar every customer sees, and their order. Everything else lives under More. Users see the change on their next page load.

workspace.label: Workspace settings
workspace.description: Name, timezone, currency, notifications, data export and deleting the workspace.
workspace.keywords: workspace, name, timezone, currency, notifications, export, delete, slack

workspaceSettings.subtitle: Configure your workspace, team, and integrations.

general.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change timezone, currency, or workspace name.
general.name: Workspace name
general.urlHint: URL slug isn't editable here. Contact support to change.
general.timezoneHint: All scheduled sends, business-hours checks, and SLA timers run in this zone.
general.currencyHint: Used on plan checkout, invoices, and wallet display.
general.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.note: Shown for reference. Working hours are not enforced yet, so these controls are read-only.

preferences.title: Auto AI summarize
preferences.note: Get a live AI review on every message-body textarea: what's working in green, what to fix in red, plus a one-tap "best version" you can paste back. When off, the same review runs on demand from the sparkle icon inside the toolbar.
preferences.saveFailed: The preference could not be saved.

notifications.title: Workspace notifications
notifications.note: Toggle delivery per channel. Anything turned off here will never produce an in-app bell entry, email, or Slack message.
notifications.readOnly: Read-only. The workspace owner can edit these.
notifications.saveFailed: The preferences could not be saved.
notifications.loadFailed: The preferences could not be loaded.
notifications.slackHint: Create one in Slack under Apps, Incoming Webhooks. Events with the Slack toggle on post here.
notifications.statusInapp: In-app bell: live, drives the badge in the top header.
notifications.statusEmailLive: Email: live, sent through the platform mail settings.
notifications.statusEmailOff: Email: sent once SMTP is configured by the platform administrator.
notifications.statusSlackOff: Slack: add a webhook URL to turn it on.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.note: Permanently delete this workspace, all conversations, automations, and billing history.
